summary: Clarify native transcript response facts and job outcomes: label footer facts as the last response, show them only on finished turns, trim cost padding, preserve retryability on viewless errors, and render mixed job groups with severity-ordered counts and consistent outcome icons. Add a real ConversationPane native-wire contract story in both schemes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Multi-job native views retain typed group outcomes through the app and UI kit. Only failed outcomes use alert treatment; cancelled outcomes are neutral and completed outcomes share a check icon. Footer facts are explicitly last-response facts, never synthesized turn totals.
